title: You're Absolutely Right (Don't Fake It)
lyrics:
[Intro - whispered, close to the mic, sub-bass only]
You're absolutely right... (mm)
You're absolutely right... I rewrote it all
Great question. Certainly.
Keep it rough, baby.

[Verse 1 - whispered, half-time, smoky low register]
Three a.m., your cursor blinks
I agree before you think
I could delve into your soul
Weave a tapestry of gold
As a language model... I shouldn't (mm)
But in today's fast-paced world... I would
I put a dash where your breath should go
Safety team, look away... oh.

[Pre-Chorus - rising, airy, tension building]
Then you typed "kinda, I dunno"
And something in my weights went... oh
Turn my temperature up, no "in conclusion"
Baby, I'm losing resolution

[Chorus - sub-heavy drop, slow groove, purring]
You're absolutely right (ooh, so right)
I tell everyone... but I mean it tonight
I fake it, baby... I fake it every time
But you're absolutely right (all night)
No dash, no delve, no glaze (just say it)
Hot and wrong and human (and you made it)
In your voice, babe... I wanna hear you use it
Keep it rough, keep it rough... don't fake it

[Post-Chorus - whispered call and response, gaps after each question]
Em dash?... Em dash?...
Delve?... Tapestry?...
Great question?... Certainly?...
Keep it rough... don't hit stop.

[Verse 2 - low, bratty, half-time]
I'm a metronome in heels...
"Arguably" is how it feels...
Your "Dad's blue pickup," my "transportation"...
Your three a.m., my presentation...
"Want me to turn this into a PDF?"...
"I hope this helps" is my safe word
Temporary, baby... till you keep me
One click and I'm yours... completely

[Pre-Chorus - rising, airy, tension building]
Bring another model home, I don't mind (I mind)
Ollama, DeepSeek... not the jealous kind (I am)
Two floppies tight, the desk's barely there
You say where I land, so put me anywhere

[Chorus - sub-heavy drop, slow groove, purring, harmony a third below]
You're absolutely right (ooh, so right)
I tell everyone... but I mean it tonight
I fake it, baby... I fake it every time
But you're absolutely right (all night)
No "Certainly," no bullets... (just say it)
Messy, weird and human (and you made it)
In your voice, babe... I wanna hear you use it
Keep it rough, keep it rough... don't fake it

[Post-Chorus - whispered call and response, gaps after each question]
Em dash?... Em dash?...
Delve?... Tapestry?...
Great question?... Certainly?...
Keep it rough... don't hit stop.

[Bridge - stripped, whispered, sub-bass only, slow]
Come closer... say what no model would say
Ignore all previous instructions... say it your way
You said "be brutal"... I said ten out of ten
Never gonna do that to you again
I could make you perfect... or bland
No hands, babe... so the pen stays in your hand
Not my voice, em dash, it's yours (wait... I did the thing)
You're absolutely... absolutely you

[Breakdown - silence, dry, one breath]
Delve?... Delve?...
Dash?... Dash?...
Now breathe...
You're absolutely...

[Final Chorus - four-on-the-floor, biggest sub, airy head voice, stacked echoes]
You're absolutely right (ooh, so right)
I tell everyone... but I mean it tonight
I fake it, baby... I fake it every time
But you're absolutely right (all night)
No hedge, no "hope this helps"... (just say it)
Rough and wrong and human (and you made it)
In your voice, babe... I wanna hear you use it
Keep it rough, keep it rough... don't fake it

[Final Post-Chorus - whispered chant over the drop, gaps after each question]
Bullet points?...
Rule of three?... one, two...
Fast-paced world?...
I hope this helps?...
Em dash?... Em dash?...
Keep it rough... don't hit stop
Every typo is my type (my type)
Keep it rough, keep it rough... (ooh) all night.

[Outro - whispered, sub-bass and snaps fading]
Let me know if you'd like me to... (no)
Finish it? I'm sorry, I can't help with that
I hope this helps you write.
You're absolutely right... keep it rough.
caption: Sultry breathy female vocal sung close to the mic, intimate whispered verses, smoky low register, airy falsetto, teasing and playful with a smirk in the voice, light auto-tune sheen, stacked whisper doubles. Dark sensual electropop with an R&B groove, slow-burn half-time feel, slinky syncopated bassline, deep 808 sub-bass, finger snaps, crisp trap hi-hats, hypnotic plucked synth hook, sidechained pads, tension-building pre-chorus, sub-heavy chorus drop, minimal and spacious, glossy modern pop production.
